full_page.content:
c. 1942
The following is a faithful transcription of the autograph written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap. in two volumes of the "Mystical City of God"
Dear Reader :-
Man's greatest benefit next to his creation, was his Redemption by Jesus Christ. The Incarnation as wonderful- ly treated in the following pages was the beginning (in a way) of that great Mystery of Love.
Learn about that you may begin to appreciate it here when only in Heaven will be understood.
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
Book in possession of: Dr. Bernadine Schefneker 4800 Cadieux Rd. Detroit, Mich. 48224
c. 1951
To read such work in any other than in a spirit of humility, is to read it to no profitable purpose. - in vain - This even with every kind of education and gen- ius. Many read it - rather pray it on their knees.
Glory be to God for such a work - Even the abridged.
Fr. Solanus
Book in possession of: Mrs. Deloris Tchakerian 615 Massoit Clawson, Mich. 48017
